hypotheses.statement: Increasing steady heater power u increases steady temperature y (positive static gain).
Step response is lagged, not instantaneous: visible rise takes seconds to start and settling takes more than 60 s.
No large dead zone: u at or above 0.2 produces a clear positive slope, i.e. dead zone is below 0.2 if any exists.
With u=0, y decays on its own toward ambient near 0.05 (self-cooling heat loss).
Steady-state y is approximately linear in u, so the u needed to hold y=0.5 is in mid-range 0.3-0.7.
Sensor short-term noise and fluctuations are small, less than 0.02 peak-to-peak, relative to the 0.05 target band.
